headline: Google says its investments in AI are driving more searches
summary: Google's AI investments are significantly boosting search queries. Q3 2026 earnings show the highest year-over-year query growth rate. CEO Sundar Pichai confirms AI is driving commercial queries.

headline: Microsoft reveals strong cloud growth amid financial reporting overhaul
summary: Microsoft reports $92.3 billion revenue and $33.6 billion net income in Q1 2027. Revenue increased 19%, with net income up 32%. The company is overhauling its financial reporting methods.

headline: Apple charges $14,549 for a fully specced touchscreen MacBook Pro
summary: New MacBook Pro with OLED display and touchscreen is significantly pricier. Fully upgrading the 14-inch or 16-inch models can cost up to $14,549. Base models start at $2,899 (14-inch) and $3,399 (16-inch).

headline: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon with a ‘significant leap’ in cybersecurity
summary: Google's new Gemini 4 Carbon model offers major advancements in coding and cybersecurity. It ranks highest on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (v5.0) benchmark. The model also provides "significant gains" in agentic tasks.

headline: Save $700 Off the HyperX OMEN Gaming Laptop With GeForce RTX 5060 (115W) Graphics
summary: Get a $700 discount on the HyperX OMEN Gaming Laptop. Features GeForce RTX 5060 (115W) graphics. This laptop offers more power than a comparably priced Steam Machine.

headline: Winnie-the-Pooh: Blood and Honey 3 Exclusive Trailer
summary: IGN reveals the exclusive first trailer for "Winnie-the-Pooh: Blood and Honey 3". Director Scott Chambers describes the sequel as "absolute carnage." The slasher film is set to release in late January 2027.

headline: The Steelseries Arctis Nova Pro Omni Gaming Headset With Infinite Battery Life Drops to a New Price Low
summary: The Steelseries Arctis Nova Pro Omni gaming headset reaches a new low price. It features innovative "infinite battery life." This headset is the successor to the highly regarded Arctis Nova Pro.

headline: Save $200 Off the 27" Samsung Odyssey OLED G6 240Hz Gaming Monitor Ahead of Black Friday
summary: Save $200 on the 27" Samsung Odyssey OLED G6 gaming monitor. Features a 240Hz refresh rate and OLED technology. Includes a 3-year warranty covering OLED burn-in.

headline: Healey unveils £100 for energy bills and bank tax in first Budget
summary: Chancellor Healey's first Budget includes a £100 payment for energy bills. He also introduces a new bank tax. The measures aim to tackle the cost of living amidst global economic turmoil.

headline: Key points at a glance
summary: This article summarizes John Healey's first Budget. It outlines the government's tax and spending plans. Provides essential takeaways from the Chancellor's announcements.

headline: Chris Mason: Budget felt cautious despite its range of small measures
summary: BBC's Chris Mason describes the Budget as cautious. The Chancellor grapples with challenging public and household finances. Despite various small measures, it lacked bold moves.

headline: The main announcements from the Budget - and how they will be funded
summary: BBC's Joe Pike explains the Chancellor's key Budget announcements. It details the major measures outlined in the Budget. The article also covers how these plans will be funded.
